notes.title: Update - Mission Files
notes.notes:
Mission Files adds a recap in the beggining of the Leviathan campaign, allowing for new and old players to learne about the events of prior games.

[list]
[*] This update also includes controller compatibility. 
[/list] 


Stay tuned for [b]Grand Finale[/b], the final free expansion update for Calmed by the Dark Leviathan!

notes.title: Calmed by the the Dark Re:Boot
notes.notes:
Calmed by the Dark Re:Boot takes place a few years after the events of the original Leviathan campaign, introducing a new protagonist, AJ, and a brand new storyline. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/59637526cd8bfdd368198da7d2e20d9a3cbe0b5f.png[/img]

In this new mode, players will embark on an epic journey and explore new areas, battle new enemies and bosses. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/3ac7b273a95e714b18c56560024d84dbe373cab2.png[/img]

With new weapons to wield and skills to master, players will need to hone their combat abilities to take on the challenges ahead. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/fbcee06810b890155578ed5d807b643783b56875.png[/img]

Are you ready to continue this new era of Calmed by the Dark? 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/e9ea23be97fb2df18b8e36b2b970e6c04d9f23e1.png[/img]



​Like past updates, this expansion is a free update and the player will be able to play it by selecting it in the "New Game" menu.

notes.title: Steam Awards 2022
notes.notes:
Calmed by the Dark Leviathan can be nominated for 'Labor of Love' on Steam Awards!
Since it's release, Calmed by the Dark Leviathan received big updates, such as Re:Iterate and In:Finity, both containing new gameplay mechanics and stories. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/fdf29df6d410397c278e095aaf021fb06ddcaff4.png[/img]


Even though the focus right now is on developing our next game, Calmed by the Dark Re:boot, Calmed by the Dark Leviathan still has 3 big updates planned for the next years!

notes.title: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan - In:Finity
One Year anniversary and announcement
notes.notes:
A year ago we released 'Calmed by the Dark Leviathan' on Itchio, and in November it launched on Steam with Purgatorium mode.

Today we announce its new free expansion 'In:Finity', a new story mode with more focus on an RPG experience, is planned to be released in January.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40776797/54878ea04c921cc1650d3d4073fae835968bd4ab.png[/img]

notes.title: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan - RE:Iterate
notes.notes:
[b] RE:Iterate, the free expansion for Calmed by the Dark Leviathan, is available now![/b]
[previewyoutube=AJjDphb8XuA;full][/previewyoutube]
 The expansion is a free update and the player will be able to play by selecting  it in the "New Game" menu.

This  is a new timeline for Calmed by the Dark and, with it, new characters, lore and story  will be introduced. Different from the main story or the Purgatorium mode, RE:iterate has a more linear and narrative focused experience with a combat inspired by older Beat'em up games.

Brief story of RE:Iterate :   Across the city, people are being mysteriously kidnapped and they are never seen again. Eve, the protagonist, was just looking for a job and somehow ended up discovering a strange world where she awakens her powers and learn the truth behind the kidnappings...

RE:iterate is avaliable now as a update for Calmed by the Dark Leviathan.

notes.title: Calmed by the Dark Leviathan - Available Now!
notes.notes:
Calmed by the Dark Leviathan is available now!


But this isn't the end yet...

[b]Re:iterate[/b] will be a new story mode in Calmed by the Dark Leviathan that will bring a different experience for the game, with a brand new timeline and new gameplay mechanics!
